purpose: Teach: 瓩/屬/璽/錣/註/楼/个/北村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、瓩、つまりキロ表記の電卓を愛用された
lines.en: Father, in his younger days, he had great affection for calculators marked in kilograms.
lines.style: Gentle, observational opening. Voice settles into memory. Pace unhurried, like setting pieces on a board. Warmth beneath the specificity—not lecturing, remembering aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは旧字「屬」、つまり属の組織図を懐かしまれた
lines.en: Yes. Father held dear the old organizational charts—the way they showed belonging and connection.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. A beat of agreement that honors what was said. Voice steady and grounded. Speaking from understanding, not just response.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社印、つまり璽を毎日御自ら押された
lines.en: Father, in his younger days, he would stamp the company seal himself each day.
lines.style: Soft nostalgia in the delivery. Small emphasis on the ritual—the act itself mattered. Voice trails slightly, inviting acknowledgment of the care in daily things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは家紋入りの錣、つまり兜飾りを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father treasured the family-crest helmet ornament—kept it close to him always.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial tone. Voice honors the object through deliberate pacing. Slight weight on 'treasured'—not casual affection but active, chosen care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、契約書の註、つまり細字までお読みになった
lines.en: Father, in his younger days, he would read even the fine print of contracts—every annotation.
lines.style: Voice gentle but carries conviction about the detail. Slight emphasis on 'even.' Pace deliberate. Wistfulness mixed with quiet admiration for that thoroughness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新築の楼、つまり高楼ビルの竣工式に出られた
lines.en: Yes. Father attended the dedication ceremony for the new building—that tall new office tower.
lines.style: Affirmation with quiet presence. Voice marks the significance without overdoing it. Straightforward, honoring the memory with simple clarity and dignity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、台帳の个、つまり個の単位を御自ら数えられた
lines.en: Father, in his younger days, he would count the ledger entries himself—each single item.
lines.style: Voice soft with admiration for the meticulousness. Gentle emphasis on 'himself.' Wistful pacing. The specificity carries weight—it's not just work, it's care made concrete.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは旧友の北村氏との関係を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father kept his friendship with Kitamura—an old friend—very close to his heart.
lines.style: Warm closing affirmation. Voice softens slightly on the name and the friendship itself. Steady, knowing tone. The kind of agreement that understands relationships outlast most things.
